title: Flying saucer
abstract: A saucer-shaped throwing implement made of plastic with a central portion and rim. The innovation features concentric ridges on the convex surface that create air flow disruption, reducing aerodynamic drag and improving flight stability.
gist: The modern Frisbee: a plastic flying disc whose concentric ridges on the top surface act as spoilers, creating a turbulent boundary layer that reduces drag and stabilises flight, so even beginners throw it straight.
